chunks: And we are those who sing hallelujas to Him.
ai.seo_question: Who are the ones who glorify God according to Surah As-Saff?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah As-Saff, this verse highlights the continuous state of glorification (tasbih) as a defining trait of the believers, often interpreted by Shia scholars as reflecting the spiritual vigilance and obedience of the Ahl al-Bayt and the faithful community. It underscores that true faith is manifested not just in belief but in the perpetual act of sanctifying God, distinguishing the sincere from the hypocrites who may appear in ranks but lack this inner reality.
